HPC Operations and Cost Optimization Designed for Spot Instance Interruptions — Practices and Lessons from Numerical Relativity Simulations
items.summary: English abridged translation of talk A42 at the OpenCAE Symposium 2026 (Kanazawa, Japan, November 2026). The Japanese deck is the original.A 45 h 33 min numerical-relativity run (Einstein Toolkit, black hole-neutron star merger) completed on AWS Spot Instances through 13 interruptions and a relay of 14 nodes. It cost 136 USD, about 55% less than on-demand, and matched the reference solution. The infrastructure is plain, open-source Terraform. The approach should transfer to any solver that can restart from checkpoints.Japanese version: https://speakerdeck.com/syotasasaki593876/slides-73ec3dbb-9cf2-401d-98b2-c135017411bc
